description: The file defines a migration class for upgrading the database schema and data related to email configuration in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for updating email settings and schema modifications specific to version 4.3.2.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Represents a database migration script for version 4.3.2, extending the AbstractMigration class and implementing the upgrade logic including schema changes and data updates.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the database schema and data modifications for the migration, including updating the email configuration and schema structure.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string associated with this migration ('4.3.2').
